description: This Java class defines a converter for styleable names in Android resource XML files, providing reference resolution and code completion features within an IDE.

classes.name: DeclareStyleableNameConverter
classes.description: A converter class for Android styleable names, implementing reference creation and resolution for IDE features.

classes.name: MyReference
classes.description: Inner class providing reference resolution and code completion for styleable names within the converter.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Returns the input string as-is; used to convert from string to internal representation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the internal string representation as-is; used for display or serialization.

methods.name: createReferences
methods.description: Creates PSI references for a given DOM value, enabling navigation and code completion.

methods.name: multiResolve
methods.description: Resolves references to target classes, with caching for performance.

methods.name: resolveInner
methods.description: Performs the actual resolution of the styleable name to corresponding classes.

methods.name: getVariants
methods.description: Provides code completion variants by searching for subclasses of the Android View class.
